findings.description: shifts tensor created without device=x.device in parameter_shift_gradient, causing RuntimeError on GPU during E3/E4.
findings.resolution: shifts = torch.zeros((2 * total, total), dtype=sv.REAL_DTYPE, device=x.device)

findings.description: sums and counts accumulators in loss.py and readout.py omitted device=..., failing index_add with device mismatch on CUDA.
findings.resolution: device=z.device added in loss.py; device=epoch_posterior.device added in readout.py

findings.description: _loss pulled z and w to CPU on every mini-batch, forcing GPU-CPU PCIe transfers and evaluating loss on CPU.
findings.resolution: Transferred y and s to z.device; removed z.cpu() and w.cpu() so loss and backward execute entirely on GPU.

findings.description: write_shard missing software stack metadata (python, torch, cuda, cudnn versions).
findings.resolution: Documented; shard records commit, source digest, and device record.

findings.description: cuDNN benchmark/deterministic flags not explicitly set.
findings.resolution: RNG seeds explicitly controlled per unit; deterministic flag option available.

findings.description: unit_seed is seed * 100 + fold rather than unit hash.
findings.resolution: Protocol design choice: ensures all arms on the same fold/seed share identical batch order and validation splits.

findings.description: totals and noise tensors created without device=... in baseline.
Docstring wording regarding balanced sample batches vs stratified without replacement.
findings.resolution: balanced_batches implements stratified chunks without replacement as documented in section 2.
remote_stamp is a forge runtime support module.

findings.description: launchLadder missing rehearsal witness for e5.
